caveats: Region bounds 57.83-59.03N/17.41-18.61E fall between grid points of the 0.02-deg grid; cells used are lat 57.84-59.02, lon 17.42-18.60 (60x60). Sea cells: finite SST on all 92 target days (3294 of 3600). Thresholds are the hazen (type-5) 90th percentile of the +-5-day baseline pools (1992-2002 pools, edge windows 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05 included), day 60 set to the mean of days 59 and 61, then 31-day centred wrap-around smoothed; climatology computed analogously but not needed for detection. Per-cell MHWs: runs of >=5 hot days, gaps of <=2 non-hot days joined. 306 land cells (non-finite) masked as 0.
